CREATE TABLE applications (
	source_application_id TEXT, 
	company TEXT, 
	role TEXT, 
	job_url TEXT, 
	job_description TEXT, 
	submitted_at TEXT, 
	submitted_resume_reference TEXT, 
	source_resume_profile_id TEXT, 
	source_status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	normalized_status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_created_at TEXT, 
	source_updated_at TEXT, 
	historical INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_at_baseline INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	missing_fields TEXT NOT NULL, 
	research_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	selected INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	first_seen TEXT, 
	first_confirmed TEXT, 
	job_id TEXT, 
	detail_checked TEXT, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	source_job_status TEXT, 
	hiring_outcome TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown' NOT NULL, 
	outcome_note TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	outcome_updated_at TEXT, 
	details_checked_at TEXT, 
	details_error TEXT, 
	company_website TEXT, 
	locations TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (source_application_id), 
	CHECK (historical IN (0,1))
)


CREATE TABLE baseline (
	singleton SERIAL, 
	fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, 
	imported_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	record_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	automation_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (singleton), 
	CHECK (singleton=1)
)


CREATE TABLE baseline_members (
	application_id TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE engineering_migrations (
	version SERIAL, 
	applied_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version)
)


CREATE TABLE experience (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	project TEXT NOT NULL, 
	technologies TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_reference TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	embedding TEXT, 
	embedding_model TEXT, 
	embedding_dimension INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE preparation_epochs (
	application_id TEXT, 
	epoch INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE preparation_resume_requests (
	application_id TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE research_cache (
	application_id TEXT, 
	sources TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE settings (
	id SERIAL, 
	data TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (id=1)
)


CREATE TABLE sync_runs (
	id SERIAL, 
	state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	started_at TEXT, 
	finished_at TEXT, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	next_attempt DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT 0, 
	error TEXT, 
	observed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, 
	added INTEGER DEFAULT 0, 
	eligible INTEGER DEFAULT 0, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE contacts (
	id SERIAL, 
	application_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT, 
	title TEXT, 
	company TEXT, 
	linkedin_url TEXT, 
	rank INTEGER, 
	evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	relevance TEXT NOT NULL, 
	uncertainty TEXT NOT NULL, 
	connection_status TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown' NOT NULL, 
	review_status TEXT DEFAULT 'needs_review' NOT NULL, 
	review_note TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	review_source TEXT, 
	reviewed_at TEXT, 
	dismissed INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	original_fields TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (source_application_id), 
	UNIQUE (application_id, source_key)
)


CREATE TABLE descriptions (
	application_id TEXT, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	provenance TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (source_application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE jobs (
	application_id TEXT, 
	state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0, 
	next_attempt DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT 0, 
	error TEXT, 
	stage TEXT DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (source_application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE match_reviews (
	application_id TEXT, 
	data TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (source_application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE posting_role_checks (
	application_id TEXT, 
	posting_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT, 
	checked_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (source_application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE posting_roles (
	application_id TEXT, 
	role TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	posting_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	method TEXT NOT NULL, 
	checked_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	saved_at TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (source_application_id)
)


CREATE TABLE preparation_runs (
	id TEXT, 
	application_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	input_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (source_application_id), 
	UNIQUE (application_id, input_version)
)


CREATE TABLE draft_suggestions (
	id TEXT, 
	contact_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	dm TEXT NOT NULL, 
	grounding TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(contact_id) REFERENCES contacts (id)
)


CREATE TABLE drafts (
	contact_id INTEGER, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	dm TEXT NOT NULL, 
	grounding TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (contact_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(contact_id) REFERENCES contacts (id)
)


CREATE TABLE outreach_events (
	id SERIAL, 
	contact_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	request_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	undone_at TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(contact_id) REFERENCES contacts (id), 
	UNIQUE (request_id)
)


CREATE TABLE draft_feedback (
	id SERIAL, 
	suggestion_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	accepted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	edited INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(suggestion_id) REFERENCES draft_suggestions (id), 
	UNIQUE (suggestion_id)
)
